newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Koh Brothers unit offers new shares.
newsitem.headline: Koh Brothers unit offers new shares.

text.p: Koh Brothers Group Ltd (KBGL) said on Friday its G&W Group (Holdings) Ltd unit will extend an offer of 8.13 million new shares to its shareholders.
The non-renounceable preferential shares would be for all shareholders of KBGL other than Koh & Koh Investments Ltd, it said in a statement.
It said the offer would be on the basis of one preferential offer share for every 10 existing ordinary shares of $0.10 each in the capital of KBGL.
The offer would be at a fixed price between the range of $0.48 to $0.50 per preferential share.
The purpose of the offer was to provide eligible KBGL shareholders an opportunity to take part in the equity of G&W.
The Stock Exchange of Singapore has given approval in principle for the listing of G&W Group on the mainboard.
G&W Group will issue 27 million new ordinary shares of Singapore $0.20 each, representing 25 percent of its enlarged share capital.
The preferential share offer is subject to the initial public offering of G&W Holdings proceeding, the statement said.
